arxiv-2106-05333.title: Assorted Musings on Dimension-critical Graphs
arxiv-2106-05333.creator: Matt Noble
arxiv-2106-05333.description: Abstract For a finite simple graph G G , say G G is of dimension n n , and write dim ( G ) = n \dim(G)=n , if n n is the smallest integer such that G G can be represented as a unit-distance graph in ℝ n \mathbb{R}^{n} .

arxiv-2106-08107.title: ResDepth : A Deep Residual Prior For 3D Reconstruction From High-resolution Satellite Images Journal: ISPRS Journal of Photogrammetry and Remote Sensing
arxiv-2106-08107.creator: Corinne Stucker, Konrad Schindler
arxiv-2106-08107.description: Abstract Modern optical satellite sensors enable high-resolution stereo reconstruction from space. But the challenging imaging conditions when observing the Earth from space push stereo matching to its limits. In practice, the resulting digital surface models (DSMs) are fairly noisy and often do not attain the accuracy needed for high-resolution applications such as 3D city modeling.

arxiv-2203-06820.title: Edge Detection and Image Filter algorithms for Spectroscopic Analysis with Deep Learning Applications
arxiv-2203-06820.creator: Christopher Sims
arxiv-2203-06820.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Christopher Sims. Edge detection and image filters are commonly used in computer vision. However, they have never been applied to the data analysis of angle resolved photoemission spectroscopy (ARPES) data before in a systematic fashion. In this paper we will use the Sobel, laplacian of a gaussian (LoG), Canny, Prewitt, Roberts, and fuzzy logic methods for edge detection in the ARPES results of HfP 2 , ZrSiS, and Hf 2 Te 2 P 2 .

arxiv-2207-10382.title: Canonical Witt formal scheme extensions and p p -torsion groups
arxiv-2207-10382.creator: Alessandra Bertapelle 1, Nicola Mazzari 1, Arnab Saha 2
arxiv-2207-10382.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Alessandra Bertapelle 1, Nicola Mazzari 1, Arnab Saha 2. We study the n n -th arithmetic jet space of the p p -torsion subgroup attached to a smooth commutative formal group scheme. We show that the n n -th jet space above fits in the middle of a canonical short exact sequence between a power of the formal scheme of Witt vectors of length n n and the p p -torsion subgroup we started with.

arxiv-2209-10810.description: Abstract . In this paper, we define the potential log canonical threshold and prove the ascending chain condition (ACC) of the set of these thresholds satisfies. We also consider collections of Fano type varieties and study their basic properties including boundedness. 1. The full collection is available at https
arxiv-2306-02932.creator: Misha GROMOV ab
arxiv-2306-02932.description: Abstract We study metric invariants of Riemannian manifolds X X defined via the 𝕋 ⋊ \mathbb{T}^{\rtimes} - stabilized scalar curvatures of manifolds Y Y mapped to X X and prove in some cases additivity of these invariants under Riemannian products X 1 × X 2 X_{1}\times X_{2} .

arxiv-2311-04035.title: Discordance Minimization-based Imputation Algorithms for Missing Values in Rating Data
arxiv-2311-04035.creator: Young Woong Park, Jinhak Kim, Dan Zhu
arxiv-2311-04035.description: Abstract Ratings are frequently used to evaluate and compare subjects in various applications, from education to healthcare, because ratings provide succinct yet credible measures for comparing subjects. However, when multiple rating lists are combined or considered together, subjects often have missing ratings, because most rating lists do not rate every subject in the combined list.

arxiv-2409-05713.title: The Surprising Robustness of Partial Least Squares
arxiv-2409-05713.creator: João B. Assunção
arxiv-2409-05713.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by João B. Assunção. Partial least squares (PLS) is a simple factorisation method that works well with high dimensional problems in which the number of observations is limited given the number of independent variables. In this article, we show that PLS can perform better than ordinary least squares (OLS), least absolute shrinkage and selection operator (LASSO) and ridge regression in forecasting quarterly gross domestic product (GDP) growth, covering the period from 2000 to 2023.

arxiv-2410-12764.title: Polarization options in inclusive DIS off tensor polarized deuteron
arxiv-2410-12764.creator: Wim Cosyn, Brandon Roldan Tomei, Alan Sosa, Allison Zec
arxiv-2410-12764.description: Abstract In the near future, the Jefferson Lab b 1 b_{1} experiment will provide the second measurement of tensor polarized asymmetries in inclusive DIS on the deuteron. In this asymmetry, 4 independent tensor polarized structure functions contribute. This necessitates systematic approximations in the extraction of the leading twist structure function b 1 b_{1} from a single tensor asymmetry measurement.

arxiv-2411-06711.title: Anytime Probabilistically Constrained Provably Convergent Online Belief Space Planning
arxiv-2411-06711.creator: Andrey Zhitnikov, Vadim Indelman, Technion Autonomous Systems Program (TASP)
arxiv-2411-06711.description: Abstract Taking into account future risk is essential for an autonomously operating robot to find online not only the best but also a safe action to execute. In this paper, we build upon the recently introduced formulation of probabilistic belief-dependent constraints. We present an anytime approach employing the Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) method in continuous domains.

arxiv-2412-04075.title: Does your model understand genes? A benchmark of gene properties for biological and text models
arxiv-2412-04075.creator: Yoav Kan-TorIBM Research - Israel Yoav.Kan-Tor@ibm.com, Michael Morris DanzigerIBM Research - Israel Michael.Danziger@ibm.com Eden ZoharIBM Research - Israel Eden.Zohar@ibm.com Matan NinioIBM Research - Israel matann@il.ibm.com Yishai ShimoniIBM Research - Israel yishais@il.ibm.com
arxiv-2412-04075.description: Abstract The application of deep learning for biology, including foundation models, has increased significantly in recent years. Some models are text-based, while others are trained on the underlying biological data, especially omics data of various modalities. Consistently comparing the performance of deep learning models for biology has proven challenging due to the diversity of training data and downstream tasks.

arxiv-2506-06699.title: MarginSel : Max-Margin Demonstration Selection for LLMs
arxiv-2506-06699.creator: Rajeev Bhatt Ambati, James Lester, Shashank Srivastava, Snigdha Chaturvedi
arxiv-2506-06699.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Rajeev Bhatt Ambati, James Lester, Shashank Srivastava, Snigdha Chaturvedi. Large Language Models (LLMs) excel at few-shot learning via in-context learning (ICL). However, the effectiveness of ICL is often sensitive to the selection and ordering of demonstration examples Lu et al. To address this, we present MarginSel : Max- Margin Demonstration Sel ection for LLMs, a two-step method that selects hard demonstration examples for the ICL prompt, adapting to each test instance.

arxiv-2506-18511.title: Standard Applicability Judgment and Cross-jurisdictional Reasoning: A RAG-based Framework for Medical Device Compliance
arxiv-2506-18511.creator: Yu Han, Aaron Ceross, Jeroen H.M. Bergmann
arxiv-2506-18511.description: Abstract Identifying the appropriate regulatory standard applicability remains a critical yet understudied challenge in medical device compliance, frequently necessitating expert interpretation of fragmented and heterogeneous documentation across different jurisdictions. To address this challenge, we introduce a modular AI system that leverages a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipeline to automate standard applicability determination.

arxiv-2510-27286.title: Differential Models for Anderson Dual to Twisted SPIN c \text{SPIN}^{c} -Bordism and Twisted Anomaly Map
arxiv-2510-27286.creator: Fei Han, Yuanchu Li
arxiv-2510-27286.description: Abstract . We construct differential models for twisted Spin c \mathrm{Spin}^{c} -bordism and for its Anderson dual, and employ the latter to define a twisted anomaly map whose source is the differential twisted K K -theory. Our differential model for the twisted Anderson dual follows the formalism developed in YY 23 .

pmc-10712865.title: Exponential adoption of battery electric cars
pmc-10712865.creator: Felix Jung, Malte Schröder, Marc Timme
pmc-10712865.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). The adoption of battery electric vehicles (BEVs) may significantly reduce greenhouse gas emissions caused by road transport. However, there is wide disagreement as to how soon battery electric vehicles will play a major role in overall transportation. Focusing on battery electric passenger cars, we analyze BEV adoption across 17 individual countries, Europe, and the World, and consistently find exponential growth trends. Modeling-based estimates of future adoption given past trends suggest system-wide adoption substantially faster than typical economic analyses have proposed so far.

pmc-11471149.title: Clinical significance and underlying mechanism of long non‐coding RNA SNHG12 in lower extremity deep venous thrombosis
pmc-11471149.creator: Shun Xiao, Chong Wang, Yongxin Li, Kun Zhang, Xuefei Jiao, Zonggang Zhao, Mingjin Guo, Bing Liu
pmc-11471149.description: D‐dimer is widely used in the diagnosis of deep vein thrombosis (DVT), but the specificity is low. The study examined the diagnostic value of long non‐coding RNA (lncRNA) SNHG12 in DVT, and preliminarily discussed its mechanism. SNHG12 levels were detected in 200 elderly fracture patients via RT‐qPCR, including 38 DVTs.

pmc-11538031.title: Gallstones increase the risk of nonalcoholic fatty liver: A case‐control study
pmc-11538031.creator: Abdolreza Sheibani, Hamid Reihani, Ahmad shoja, Mohammad M. Gharibvand, Mohammad G. Hanafi
pmc-11538031.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). BackgroundNonalcoholic fatty liver disease (NAFLD) and gallstones are generally seen together, and many of the risk factors for fatty liver and gallstones are common and similar. Therefore, this study aims to investigate the relationship between NAFLD and gallstones.MethodsThis case‐control study was conducted in patients referred to Imam Khomeini and Golestan hospitals of Ahvaz University of Medical Sciences in 2023, whose ultrasound showed fatty liver.

pmc-11545769.title: The Corneal Epithelial Thickness Profile in a Healthy Saudi Population
pmc-11545769.creator: Sultan H Alrashidi
pmc-11545769.description: Introduction: Epithelial mapping appears to be a valuable technique for a corneal and refractive surgeon, useful for distinguishing corneas with the true presence of corneal ectasia from those that are suspicious. Interpreting the epithelial thickness map data requires an understanding of corneal epithelial thickness (CET) normal values and variable patterns.

pmc-11690304.title: IMPACT OF RURALITY ON PALLIATIVE CARE–RELATED SERVICE USE: FINDINGS FROM A POPULATION DATASET
pmc-11690304.creator: Djin Tay, Jia-Wen Guo, Katherine Ornstein, Kline Dubose, Xiaoming Sheng, Lee Ellington
pmc-11690304.description: Palliative care, including hospice, supports quality of life of individuals living with serious illness. However, residents in rural areas may have limited access to these services. This study examined urban/rural differences in palliative care-related service claims among older adult cancer patients diagnosed with metastatic breast, lung, colorectal, head and neck, bladder, and melanoma cancers.

pmc-12471933.title: Novel pH-Responsive PSS-Loaded Chitosan Matrix Nanoparticles Ameliorate Pressure Overload-Induced Cardiac Hypertrophy
pmc-12471933.creator: Meijie Xu, Zhen Fan, Dingfu Wang, Dan Li, Haimiao Zou, Yiting Xue, Shixin Wang, Chunxia Li, Zulema Vargas
pmc-12471933.description: Cardiac hypertrophy is a critical contributor to cardiac dysfunction and the development of heart failure, yet effective therapeutic strategies remain limited. Propylene glycol alginate sulfate sodium (PSS) is a marine sulfated polysaccharide drug used in the treatment of cardiovascular diseases and has shown cardiac function benefits. Here, we designed a pH-responsive PSS-loaded nanoparticle drug delivery system.

pmc-12613535.creator: Anna Heath, David Rios, Kristina I. Vogel, Tremaine Rowe, Natasha Wills-Ibarra, Ed Oakley, Martin Offringa, Petros Pechlivanoglou, Terry P. Klassen, Stuart R. Dalziel, Amy C. Plint, Eleanor Pullenayegum, Eleanor Pullenayegum, Jeff Round, Andy Willan, Garth Meckler, Mark Roback, Anupam Kharbanda, Eya
pmc-12613535.description: BackgroundBronchiolitis is a common lung infection that affects infants and young children. While most children can be treated at home, some require hospitalisation where supportive care, such as fluids and oxygen, is the suggested treatment. Bronchiolitis is the leading cause of infant hospitalisation in developed countries and exerts a significant burden on the healthcare system.

pmc-13579984.title: Knowledge, practices, perceived challenges, and factors associated with menstrual hygiene among adolescent school girls in southern Sri Lanka
pmc-13579984.creator: D M Y W K Dissanayaka, W M P A F Balapitiya, S M T D Sundarapperuma, P N Kariyawasam
pmc-13579984.description: BackgroundMenstrual hygiene is essential for adolescent girls, as it greatly affects their capacity to engage in academic and extracurricular activities. Adolescent girls often encounter various challenges in maintaining proper menstrual hygiene, making it essential to explore these challenges to design effective future interventions.
